text:
Nisha: Heads-up: Aurora dedicated pool cutover planned Thu 07:00 UTC. Committed quota 48k tokens/min. Need quick owners for quota verify, autoscale tuning, a 20m shadow test, and an enablement demo.

Roman: I'll validate quota at infra and confirm egress. Last-minute egress caps burned us before.

Claire: I'll take autoscale. Proposal: min nodes 3, scale step 2, scale-up threshold CPU>65% or queue>250, cooldown 45s.

AutoscaleBot: [08:10] policy-sim: 'steady-step' shows expected ramp to 8 nodes at 48k over 12m, median scale latency 40s.

Nisha: Good. Ken can you run the shadow? Use mixed prompt distribution: 80% short, 20% long. Keep an eye on long-path P95.

Ken: On it. Command I'll run:
```
w rk -t8 -c300 -d15m -s scripts/aurora_mix.lua https://staging.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Expect ~2.8k rps for shorts.

Roman: Update: customer opened cloud ticket to raise egress to 50Gbps, ETA 24h. I forwarded test VPC creds.

Claire: Shadow 1 results: sustained 44k tokens/min, P95 short=110ms, P95 long=340ms. 5xx=0.02%. Autoscale added nodes as expected, batch utilization ~72%. Logs: https://logs.internal/aurora/4745123456/shadow1

Nisha: Long latency for heavy context is high. Claire, can you add 'kv_prefetch' and reduce batch_max for long requests? Add as conditional policy.

Claire: Will do. Suggest batch_max_tokens=3072 for long-paths, enable kv_prefetch=true. Also recommend disabling aggressive scale-in during golden hour (set scale-in cooldown 5m).

DeployBot: [08:42] canary: 4% traffic route created for model 'redwood-aurora-prod'. Monitoring hooks: latency, error-rate, cpu, mem, queue-depth.

Ken: I'll run shadow #2 with kv_prefetch and new batch. Kicking off now and will post concise results.

Nisha: Renewal risk note: CSM reported concern about month-1 cost vs usage. Jules (CSM) wants a 90-day forecast and a low-cost fallback plan. I will own renewal cadence, but need a cost forecast spreadsheet from Finance.

Roman: Confirming infra: egress raised to 50Gbps. If not fully live by cutover, we delay 48h as contingency.

Claire: Shadow 2 quick read: long-path P95 dropped ~22% to ~265ms, overall P95 short 106ms, 5xx stable. Autoscale stable. Uploading short log excerpt.

Nisha: Owners assigned: Roman=quota & infra, Claire=autoscale & runbook tuning, Ken=shadow tests, Nisha=program owner + renewal cadence, CSM/Jules=cost forecast + enablement invite.

Ken: Shadow2 link: https://logs.internal/aurora/4745123456/shadow2. No visible client errors during node-drain test.

Nisha: Final asks: Claire, post the runbook snippet and conditional configs. Roman, confirm egress is green by EOD. Ken, prep a 20m recording snippet for enablement. We'll meet tomorrow 09:00 UTC for final go/no-go. :thumbsup:
